Sandbox_SafehousePlus_EnableSafehouseCre: Add the option to create a house key in the player safehouses
Sandbox_SafehousePlus_RespawnCooldown_to: When you die you need to wait this seconds before respawn
Sandbox_SafehousePlus_KeepInventory_tool: When the player dies the item on the ground is removed and spawned on the player in respawn
Sandbox_SafehousePlus_KeepStats_tooltip: When the player dies stats like panic, boredom, fatigue, etc, is saved
Sandbox_SafehousePlus_EnableSetHome_tool: Allow players to use /sethome to mark their current position as home
Sandbox_SafehousePlus_SetHomeCost_toolti: Currency cost to use /sethome. Set to 0 for free. Requires Factions Economy
Sandbox_SafehousePlus_EnableHome_tooltip: Allow players to use /home to teleport to their saved home point
Sandbox_SafehousePlus_HomeCooldown_toolt: Seconds players must wait between /home uses. Set to 0 to disable cooldown
Sandbox_SafehousePlus_HomeCost_tooltip: Currency cost to use /home. Set to 0 for free. Requires Factions Economy
Sandbox_SafehousePlus_EnableBuyHome_tool: Allow players to use /buyhome to claim the safehouse they are standing in as their home
Sandbox_SafehousePlus_BuyHomeCost_toolti: Currency cost to use /buyhome. Set to 0 for free. Requires Factions Economy
Sandbox_SafehousePlus_EnableTpa_tooltip: Allow players to send and accept teleport requests with /tpa and /tpaaccept
Sandbox_SafehousePlus_TpaCost_tooltip: Currency cost for the player who sends a /tpa request. Set to 0 for free. Requires Factions Economy
Sandbox_SafehousePlus_TpaAcceptCost_tool: Currency cost for the player who accepts a /tpaaccept request. Set to 0 for free. Requires Factions Economy
